versions.changelog:
- Added category: education in SKILL.md metadata.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Updated documentation and metadata for clarity and consistency.

- Initial release of yotta-item skill.
- Enables deterministic, local exam paper assembly and verification based on a double-entry specification and question bank.
- Produces reproducible papers (using a fixed seed), ensuring required coverage and difficulty quotas or providing a gap report.
- Paper and gap checks are strictly local, with no network or AI model dependency.
- Validates existing papers for score, section allocation, difficulty distribution, coverage, and time limits.
- Suitable for integration into CI pipelines and batch processing.
